body:
## Problem

`create_nccl_comm_from_mpi` broadcasts the NCCL unique id with `MPI.Bcast!` and then every rank immediately enters `ncclCommInitRank`, which blocks until all ranks have joined. When the ranks are on different nodes, the broadcast may not have been delivered to every rank by the time rank 0 blocks inside NCCL: MPI makes progress only inside MPI calls, and rank 0 makes no further MPI call. The remaining ranks then wait in `MPI.Bcast!` forever and the job hangs at start-up with no error.

Runs with all ranks on one node do not show this, because the shared-memory transport delivers the broadcast eagerly.

## Fix

One `MPI.Barrier(mpi_subcomm)` directly after the broadcast. The barrier returns only once every rank has completed the broadcast, so the id is delivered before any rank enters `ncclCommInitRank`.

## Verification

- Two ranks on two nodes: without the barrier the job hangs in communicator creation; with it, creation completes and a ring of `NCCL.Send` / `NCCL.Recv!` exchanges returns the right data. An MPI-only test (Bcast + Allreduce) between the same nodes passes without the barrier, which rules out MPI routing. Warming up the MPI connections with an all-pairs `Sendrecv!` before communicator creation does not remove the hang.
- Sixteen ranks on two nodes: a terrain-following compressible Breeze case runs to completion with the barrier in place.
- Single-node behaviour is unchanged apart from one extra barrier per communicator.

Verified against Oceananigans 0.117.1; the change applies unmodified to `main`. No test is added: the hang needs ranks on two nodes, which the test suite does not have. Happy to add one if there is a multi-node runner I should target.

title: Deliver the NCCL unique id to every rank before communicator creation blocks
